summaries.zh-CN: 复杂场景、材质、相机与照明的可控图像生成。

modules.title: SRW
modules.summary: Radiation from synchrotron sources and propagation through X-ray beamlines.

summaries.en: Radiation from synchrotron sources and propagation through X-ray beamlines.
summaries.zh-CN: 从电子轨迹和辐射源到束线光学的频域场与传播。

modules.title: SHADOW4 / OASYS
modules.summary: Mirrors, crystals, gratings and beam transport in synchrotron beamlines; OASYS supplies graphical workflows.

summaries.en: Mirrors, crystals, gratings and beam transport in synchrotron beamlines; OASYS supplies graphical workflows.
summaries.zh-CN: 同步辐射束线的镜、晶体、光栅与光束输运；OASYS 提供图形工作流。

modules.title: xrt
modules.summary: Synchrotron sources, crystals, mirrors and beamline calculations.

summaries.en: Synchrotron sources, crystals, mirrors and beamline calculations.
summaries.zh-CN: 同步辐射光源、晶体、镜面与束线光学计算。

modules.title: PyVISA
modules.summary: Control sources, power meters, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes and controllers with text commands and read their measurements.

summaries.en: Control sources, power meters, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes and controllers with text commands and read their measurements.
summaries.zh-CN: 用文本指令控制光源、功率计、光谱分析仪、示波器和控制器，并读取测量值。

modules.title: PyMeasure
modules.summary: Drivers that expose the settings of many laboratory instruments as properties, and procedures that run a measurement and record its data.

summaries.en: Drivers that expose the settings of many laboratory instruments as properties, and procedures that run a measurement and record its data.
summaries.zh-CN: 把多种实验仪器的设置封装为属性的驱动，以及执行测量并记录数据的流程。

modules.title: pylablib
modules.summary: Acquire frames from scientific cameras and move stages, with device classes for Andor, Hamamatsu, PCO, Thorlabs, Newport, Attocube and other makers.

summaries.en: Acquire frames from scientific cameras and move stages, with device classes for Andor, Hamamatsu, PCO, Thorlabs, Newport, Attocube and other makers.
summaries.zh-CN: 采集科学相机图像并驱动位移台，含 Andor、Hamamatsu、PCO、Thorlabs、Newport、Attocube 等厂商的设备类。

modules.title: QCoDeS
modules.summary: Describe instruments as parameters, run measurement loops and store the data with the settings of every instrument.

summaries.en: Describe instruments as parameters, run measurement loops and store the data with the settings of every instrument.
summaries.zh-CN: 把仪器描述为参数，运行测量循环，并把数据连同各仪器的设置一起保存。

modules.title: Bluesky / ophyd
modules.summary: Run scans and adaptive experiments on beamline and laboratory devices; every reading is emitted as a structured document.

summaries.en: Run scans and adaptive experiments on beamline and laboratory devices; every reading is emitted as a structured document.
summaries.zh-CN: 在束线和实验室设备上运行扫描与自适应实验；每次读数都以结构化文档发出。

modules.title: Micro-Manager (pymmcore-plus)

summaries.zh-CN: 通过 Micro-Manager 的设备适配器控制显微镜硬件并执行多维采集。

modules.title: Harvester (GenICam)
modules.summary: Acquire frames and set the features of machine-vision cameras through a GenTL producer.

summaries.zh-CN: 通过 GenTL producer 采集机器视觉相机图像并设置相机特性。

modules.title: NI-DAQmx Python
modules.summary: Read photodiode and detector voltages, generate waveforms and triggers, and count pulses with NI data-acquisition devices.

summaries.zh-CN: 用 NI 数据采集设备读取光电二极管与探测器电压、产生波形和触发、进行脉冲计数。

modules.title: python-seabreeze
modules.summary: Read spectra and set integration time and triggering of Ocean Optics USB spectrometers.

summaries.en: Read spectra and set integration time and triggering of Ocean Optics USB spectrometers.
summaries.zh-CN: 读取 Ocean Optics USB 光谱仪的光谱，设置积分时间与触发。

modules.title: slmsuite
modules.summary: Compute holograms for spot arrays and patterns, calibrate the wavefront and the mapping between camera and modulator, and drive modulators and cameras.

summaries.zh-CN: 计算光点阵列与图案的全息图，校准波前及相机与调制器之间的映射，并驱动调制器和相机。

modules.title: SymPy
modules.summary: Derive Jones / ABCD matrices, dispersion relations, derivatives, integrals and approximations.

modules.title: SageMath

summaries.zh-CN: 代数、方程、符号与数值研究；适合更复杂的理论推导。

modules.title: Julia

summaries.en: Runs Julia optics programs and packages such as QuantumOptics.jl and Luna.jl in project environments of their own.
summaries.zh-CN: 运行 Julia 光学程序，以及 QuantumOptics.jl、Luna.jl 等各自独立项目环境中的软件包。

modules.title: FreeCAD
modules.summary: Optomechanical supports, packaging, assemblies and manufacturable geometry for simulation.

modules.summary: Controlled meshes for optical FEM, thermal and structural models.

summaries.en: Controlled meshes for optical FEM, thermal and structural models.
summaries.zh-CN: 为光学 FEM、热学和结构模型生成可控网格。

modules.title: scikit-image
modules.summary: Filter, segment, register, transform and quantify experimental images.

summaries.en: Filter, segment, register, transform and quantify experimental images.
summaries.zh-CN: 实验图像的滤波、分割、配准、变换和定量分析。

modules.title: napari
modules.summary: Inspect images, volumes, labels and reconstruction results; develop analysis plugins.

summaries.en: Inspect images, volumes, labels and reconstruction results; develop analysis plugins.
summaries.zh-CN: 观察图像、体数据、标签和实验重建结果；支持开发分析插件。

modules.title: refractiveindex.info database
modules.summary: Refractive index, extinction coefficient and source literature for optical material models.

summaries.en: Refractive index, extinction coefficient and source literature for optical material models.
summaries.zh-CN: 提供材料折射率、消光系数及其文献来源，支撑各类光学模型。

modules.title: FEniCSx / DOLFINx

summaries.zh-CN: 用变分形式实现 Helmholtz、Maxwell、热学等研究模型，适合需要修改方程的场景。

modules.title: Netgen / NGSolve
modules.summary: Electromagnetic modes and custom coupled equations, with Netgen meshing.

summaries.en: Electromagnetic modes and custom coupled equations, with Netgen meshing.
summaries.zh-CN: 电磁模态和自定义耦合方程；Netgen 提供相关网格能力。

modules.title: NumPy / SciPy
modules.summary: Optical data processing, fitting, ODEs, FFTs, optimization and statistics underpin many specialized libraries.

summaries.en: Optical data processing, fitting, ODEs, FFTs, optimization and statistics underpin many specialized libraries.
summaries.zh-CN: 承载光学数据处理、参数拟合、ODE、FFT、优化与统计，是多种专业库的底层。

modules.title: JAX
modules.summary: Develop differentiable optical solvers, optimizers and surrogates; used by FDTDX and SAX.

summaries.en: Develop differentiable optical solvers, optimizers and surrogates; used by FDTDX and SAX.
summaries.zh-CN: 开发可微光学求解器、优化器和代理模型；FDTDX、SAX 等建立在其上。

modules.title: PyTorch
modules.summary: Develop joint optics-algorithm models, inverse networks and fast surrogates; used by torcwa and TorchOptics.

summaries.en: Develop joint optics-algorithm models, inverse networks and fast surrogates; used by torcwa and TorchOptics.
summaries.zh-CN: 开发光学—算法联合模型、反演网络与快速代理；torcwa、TorchOptics 等使用其后端。

summaries.zh-CN: 使用 Jones 向量、Stokes 向量、Jones 矩阵与 Mueller 矩阵计算偏振态及光学元件。
